versions.content: AttributeValueVariationPoint does not support PostBuild Variation The binding time for an AttributeValueVariation- Point is at most preCompileTime . We do not support to use such a variation point with a postBuild binding time. This is because such a behavior is already covered by calibration parameters (See [TPS_GST_00209]).

snippets.x: PreCompileTime variability Variability defined with an VariationPoint or AttributeValueVariationPoint with latest bindingTime preCompileTime.
